==English==
{{wp}}
[[File:View of the Zoological Gardens1835.jpg|thumb|A painting of the London '''Zoo''' in 1835.]]

===Etymology===
{{clip|en|zoological garden,zoological park}}, now the usual form. See {{m|en|zoology}}.

* {{senseno|en|zoophile|uc=1}} is a {{clip|en|zoophile,zoophilia|nocap=1}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/zuː/}}
* {{IPA|en|/zʉw/|a=SSB}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-zoo.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uː|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# {{lb|en|countable}} A [[park]] where [[live]] [[animal]]s are [[exhibit]]ed.
#: {{ux|en|The London '''Zoo''' was built in 1828.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-07-26|author=Nick Miroff|title=Mexico gets a taste for eating insects as chefs put bugs back on the menu|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly|url=http://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/jul/23/mexico-insect-cuisine-sustainable-food|volume=189|issue=7|page=32
|passage=The San Juan market is Mexico City's most famous deli of exotic meats, where an adventurous shopper can hunt down hard-to-find critters such as ostrich, wild boar and crocodile. Only the city '''zoo''' offers greater species diversity.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230426212645/https://www.theguardian.com/world/2013/jul/23/mexico-insect-cuisine-sustainable-food}}
# {{lb|en|countable|informal|figuratively}} Any place that is [[wild]], [[crowd]]ed, or [[chaotic]].
#: {{ux|en|The shopping center was a '''zoo''' the week before Christmas.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|informal|figuratively}} A large and varied collection of something.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1993| title=Soul in Suspense: Hitchcock's Fright and Delight |author=Neil P. Hurley | page=xii| passage=After his insightful book ''The Art of Alfred Hitchcock'', Spoto published ''The Dark Side of Genius'', a portrayal of the elderly director as a lonely man who was a veritable '''zoo''' of desires, suspicions, fears, and addictions (food, drink, romantic infatuation, and filmmaking).}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2001| title=Theory and Experiment Heading for New Physics|author=Antonino Zichichi | page=| passage=From this point on, an entire '''zoo''' of possibilities arose: strange stars, different families of neutron stars, hybrid stars, etc.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2021| title=The God Equation|author=Michio Kaku| page=| passage=But powerful as the quark model and the electroweak theory were in describing the '''zoo''' of subatomic particles, this still left a huge gap.}}
# {{lb|en|countable|US|military|slang}} The [[jungle]].
#* {{quote-web|en|date=2013-08-12|author=E. E. "Doc" Murdock|title=My Vietnam War|page=152|isbn=978-0923178239
|passage=I'm not all that unhappy about being out on an actual patrol, but there's a worried feeling wandering around the back of my mind, not exactly fear, more like a sort of lurking anxiety at being out in the dreaded jungle, the '''zoo''', where the enemy hides.}}
# {{sid|en|zoophile}} {{lb|en|countable|informal}} {{clipping of|en|zoophile}}.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2013|author=Mark Hawthorne|title=Bleating Hearts: The Hidden World of Animal Suffering
|passage=Zoophiles, or ''''zoos''',' are sexually and emotionally attracted to animals, as in a sexual orientation.}}
#* {{quote-text|en|year=2016|author=Jessica Pierce|title=Run, Spot, Run: The Ethics of Keeping Pets|page=129
|passage=Bestiality or zoophilia—whatever we decide to call it—is one of the most pressing issues for all domesticated animals, {{...}} From the scanty research available, the following picture emerges: the majority of '''zoos''' are male, though certainly not all; {{...}}}}
## {{lb|en|by extension|uncountable}} [[pornographic|Pornographic]] [[material]] depicting actual animals or [[bestiality]].
